content: **Pre-flight (architect).** polaris-backend/tests/threats/{t1..t6,common}.rs. Hermetic via testcontainers PG16-alpine. T2 (audit tamper) + T6 (moderator identity in labels) + T4 (incident dedup) are fully wired — assert behavior. T1 (moderator anomaly) + T3 (reporter rep) + T5 (frontend sanitization) — assert smallest observable invariant; ship #[ignore]+follow-up where the mitigation surface isn't complete. CI gate in ci.yml wires the threats suite as a job. Each ignored test has a rationale docstring + filed follow-up issue.
